title: Normalized models for completed-coefficient direct image
statement: For a finite extension E/Q_l and arbitrary schemes X,Y with independently sized coefficient rings, define the ordinary module categories over the completed, constant and finite quotient sheaves [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. RightImage records a total right derived functor with its universal unit and K-injective normalization. ExactImage records termwise exact localization. ExactIdentity, ExactComposition and Square retain their ordinary and derived comparisons and their representative normalization equations. SiteCoefficientData, SystemRestrictionData, SiteLimitData and SiteData record exact scalar restriction, restriction of strict semilinear systems and total tower limit. CoefficientImageData, CoefficientComparisonData and DiagramComparisonData retain the structural maps, coefficient coherence, strict diagram comparison and limit projection equations. IsReductionAugmentation is the sectionwise x to 1 tensor x formula for an actual chain map into the ordinary limit [def-weil-integral-reduction-tower]. ComparisonData further records preservation of derived completeness, strict realization, the unique reduction augmentation and invertibility of its normalized direct-image reconstruction composite [def-weil-derived-complete]. These are precisely the existing interface records, extracted without changing any declaration signature or definition.
